validation.tolerance_metric: divergence(a,b,peak) = |a-b| / max(|a|, |b|, 0.1*peak); per-feature pass: divergence ≤ 0.05; per-panel pass: > 80% of holds clear ALL features

translation_pattern: P10 (leak-relative scale check); standard voltage-gated K with m · h gates
key_observations: UNC-103 NMODL has no GLOBAL state — STATE block is standard 'm h' per-cell. The original α prompt's 'F2 GLOBAL→per-cell' framing was misattribution; F2 is about caintra1's Ca trajectory (P2 in translation_patterns.md).
Translation follows SHK-1/SHL-1/KQT-3 pattern exactly. Voltage-only gating, no Ca dependence, no special handling.
Tau functions use PRODUCT structure (not sum) — same as EGL-2: tau = (term_a) * (term_b). Translated verbatim with proper operator precedence in Brian2 eqs string.
